David built an altar to Yahweh there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on Yahweh; and he…

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and the plague was stopped.
translations.bsb: Then Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, since the plague had been halted.
translations.kjv: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.
translations.asv: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tent of meeting: and the plague was stayed.
